learning_outcomes.text: Upon successful completion of the module, students will know mathematical structures and concepts such as vectors, matrices, determinants, and systems of linear equations.

They will be able to confidently apply mathematical methods of vector and matrix calculus, assess the solvability of systems of linear equations, and solve systems of linear equations using different methods.
Students will be familiar with elementary functions of one variable and capable of analyzing them using methods of differential and integral calculus.
They will also master handling complex numbers.

syllabus_topics: Differential calculus (Elementary functions, limits, continuity, differentiability, derivative rules, applications, extreme value problems)
Integral calculus (Antiderivative, area calculation, mean value theorem, substitution, partial fraction decomposition, applications)
Complex numbers (Arithmetic, Gaussian plane, powers, roots, logarithms, Euler's equation, fundamental theorem of algebra)
